programs.title: Phineas and Ferb
programs.sub_title: Attack of the Candace Suit; Book Flub
programs.desc: Buford's Candace suit comes to life and tries to take over the real Candace's life; Candace ignores her brothers for a day in order to help her Mom with a bust of her own.

programs.title: Finding Nemo
programs.desc: Marlin (Albert Brooks), a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo (Alexander Gould), who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver, and horrified Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory (Ellen DeGeneres) -- who has a really short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank.

programs.title: Big Hero 6
programs.desc: Robotics prodigy Hiro lives in the city of San Fransokyo. Next to his older brother, Tadashi, Hiro's closest companion is Baymax, a robot whose sole purpose is to take care of people. When a devastating turn of events throws Hiro into the middle of a dangerous plot, he transforms Baymax and his other friends, Go Go Tamago, Wasabi, Honey Lemon and Fred into a band of high-tech heroes.

programs.title: Wreck-It Ralph
programs.desc: Arcade-game character Wreck-It Ralph is tired of always being the bad guy and losing to his good guy opponent, Fix-It Felix. Finally, after decades of seeing all the glory go to Felix, Ralph decides to take matters into his own hands. He sets off on a game-hopping trip to prove that he has what it takes to be a hero. However, while on his quest, Ralph accidentally unleashes a deadly enemy that threatens the entire arcade.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Bluey plays a game of "Shops" with her friends; a pool trip is a blast, until Dad forgets everything; the Heeler family plays a game and goes on an adventure.
